//: Covers the test suite, the infra scripts and the root tool configs. Deliberately NOT a composite project: the tests import service internals by relative source path (e.g. ../../services/user-service/src/app.js), which a composite project would reject because those files belong to another project's file list. Type-checking them as plain sources is exactly what we want here — it verifies the tests against the real implementation rather than against emitted declarations.
